analogy.rationale: Protein synthesis inhibitors block translation, producing a ribosome stress/translation arrest program; bacterial ribosomal subunit inhibitors hit the same translation machinery, while RNA polymerase and mTOR inhibitors also impair the protein synthesis pathway and proteasome inhibitors cause proteotoxic stress with partially overlapping signatures.
